text:
Alex: Thanks everyone for the late-night help on the latency spike. Quick follow-up: our post-incident handoff/process felt a bit ad-hoc — can we automate the PM scheduling + action tracking so we don't lose items in threads or docs?

Mira: +1. We ended up copying notes into a Google doc by hand. That took time and some action owners weren't captured properly.

Jamal: Agreed. My rough idea: a bot that can scaffold a postmortem doc populated with incident metadata, create action items in our action dashboard (and/or JIRA), and schedule the PM meeting with suggested attendees.

Sophie: Love that. Two must-haves: auto-fill customer impact section (counts, affected regions, error types) and a severity/timeline template so we don't start from scratch.

Darren: Operational command could look like: `/pmflow create --incident 1767504321 --sev=P1 --impact=customers:125 --auto-schedule` and bot does the rest (doc + tickets + invites).

Alex: Sketch of the flow I want: incident resolved -> OpsBot posts summary -> quick `/pmflow create --quick` option -> PMFlowBot: creates doc from template, creates action cards, creates JIRA issue(s) if desired, schedules review meeting, and posts a follow-up thread with links.

PMFlowBot: I can do that. Example commands:
```
/pmflow create --incident 1767504321 --sev=P2 --auto-schedule --assignees=@Mira,@Jamal
/pmflow action add --summary "Add prefix cache miss metric" --assignee @Jamal --due 2025-12-03
```

PMFlowBot: Example action payload I'll create (for dashboard/JIRA):
```json
{
  "action_id": "AI-2025-312",
  "summary": "Add metrics for prefix cache miss rate",
  "assignee": "Jamal",
  "deadline": "2025-12-03",
  "status": "open",
  "origin": "incident:1767504321"
}
```

Mira: For compliance and auditability we should also attach runbook links and include KMS/audit logs reference in the doc header. Would be great if the bot could pull the PD incident timeline automatically.

Darren: On the dashboard side, action items need tags like `pm_action`, `service:runtime`, and `sev` so we can filter and show outstanding remediation work on the SRE ops board. Also want metrics for action completion rate by owner/team.

Sophie: Reminder cadence: auto pings at 2d, 7d, 30d and escalation to manager if overdue. Also an optional cadence to auto-close low-risk items after acceptance review.

Jamal: I'll take a first pass at a prototype. Plan: wire PagerDuty/incidents API + Google Docs template + JIRA + action-dashboard webhook. ETA for prototype: 3 weeks. Will post a tracking issue on Monday.

Alex: Can we add a small template variable for "customer-facing blurb" so PMs can copy/paste a status update for status.redwood.ai or support emails?

PMFlowBot: Added. When scaffolding I will include a `customer-impact` section and optional `email_draft` block.

Mira: I'll own the postmortem templates and internal docs for the new workflow. I'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue to review the RFC and the template fields.

Darren: I'll prototype the dashboard schema and send a proto by Friday with the minimum fields we need (action_id, summary, assignee, due, status, tags, incident_id).

Alex: Decisions summary: build an MVP bot that can scaffold postmortem docs, create action items (dashboard + JIRA), and schedule the postmortem meeting. Owners: Jamal (engineering/implementation), Mira (templates/docs), Darren (dashboard). Timeline: 3 weeks for prototype, 8 weeks for full rollout. Jamal to create tracking issue `infra/tools/pmflow`.

Jamal: Will create the tracking issue and drop the prototype link here when ready. Also will add a small acceptance checklist: doc scaffolded, action card created, JIRA issue created (optional), meeting invite sent, and first reminder scheduled.

OpsBot: Incident 1767504321 — handoff recorded. Thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/eng-sre/p1767504321.

Sophie: One more thing — include a toggle to opt-out of auto-scheduling for ad-hoc incidents. Some smaller infra items don't need a meeting.

Mira: Good call. We'll include `--no-schedule` and `--quick` flags.

Alex: Thanks all — this should cut down friction and stop us losing follow-ups in threads. Please update tracking issue with any blockers.

Darren: Noted. I'll add a couple sample dashboard mockups to the issue.

Jamal: Creating issue now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issues/4132 (will update).

Mira: I'll create the RFC doc folder and link it in the issue.

PMFlowBot: When prototype is available I can post a demo and provide `/pmflow` help text for the team.

Alex: End of thread — thanks.
